title: AI Agent Verification: What a Success Signal Actually Proves
description:
A completion signal does not establish that a task produced the intended result. This video compares external result checks, decision notes, code-review benchmarks and monitoring, including the limits of the available evidence.

Agent Engineering Brief | Yunji Seo
Assessment as of October 16, 2026.

Sources:
https://stackoverflow.blog/2026/10/08/a-green-exit-code-is-not-evidence-that-the-work-happened/
https://github.blog/ai-and-ml/github-copilot/reviewbench-an-open-benchmark-for-ai-code-review/
https://stackoverflow.blog/2026/10/09/taking-a-look-under-your-agent-s-hood/
https://www.latent.space/p/thariq

Limitations: The evidence relies heavily on provider accounts and practitioner perspectives. It does not establish measured benefits or adoption costs for student teams. Announced plans are distinguished from verified capabilities.
